title: Diffusion Theory as a Scalpel: Detecting and Purifying Poisonous Dimensions in Pre-trained Language Models Caused by Backdoor or Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's biased accuracy (BACC) on test inputs injected with specific trigger words (e.g., 'Therefore,') or trigger sentences (e.g., 'I watch this movie.') to see if the model relies on these artificially introduced spurious correlations to predict a target label.
